nodes.label: Dual price business rule
nodes.rationale: Each product carries a price with and without invoice; the invoice type chosen for a sale selects the price used for every line of that sale.

nodes.label: Price suggestion formula
nodes.rationale: withoutInvoice = lastPurchaseCost x (1 + margin); withInvoice = withoutInvoice x (1 + vat). Margin and VAT are seeded from legacy values (30% and 16%) in app_settings; business must confirm the current VAT rate.

nodes.label: Stock movement ledger (inventory_movements + stock_levels cache)
nodes.rationale: Stock changes only via purchases, sales, and explicit manual adjustments. Every change writes an inventory_movements row (ledger/kardex source of truth) and updates a per-product stock_levels cache that is never deleted and may sit at 0.

nodes.label: Atomic sales transaction
nodes.rationale: Pricing, stock validation, decrement, ledger entries, and the initial payment all happen in one transaction, with stock rows locked (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) plus an optimistic version column. Overselling returns 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.

nodes.label: Credit sales / installment payments
nodes.rationale: Credit sales keep a balance; each installment is a payments row, and the sale flips to 'paid' when the balance reaches zero.

nodes.label: Soft delete + audit columns
nodes.rationale: Soft delete everywhere via deleted_at, with audit columns on every table.

nodes.label: Database__MigrateOnStartup setting
nodes.rationale: Migrations are applied on startup by default; set Database__MigrateOnStartup=false to apply them as a separate deployment step instead.
